answer: Cross-epoch behavioural consistency rule. Each identity gets a persistent behavioural anchor: a vector of task-type, counterparty-diversity, and outcome-accuracy statistics that must stay within a bounded distance across epochs. An identity whose behaviour drifts sharply (a fresh key mimicking a veteran's profile) triggers a challenge requiring it to reproduce prior work traces. A single willow-like flexible identity can flex once; maintaining dozens of consistent pseudonyms forces each to replicate genuine work history. The ripple of a detected inconsistency invalidates all linked keys.
